label: Environment
description: Environment variables from one scope or all of them.

label: System profile
description: Computer name, Windows version and build, BIOS and other inventory.

label: Power plan
description: Active power plan, the other plans and whether the PC is on mains power.

label: Reboot required
description: Whether Windows is waiting for a restart.

label: Resource usage
description: CPU load, memory and page file use, and the busiest processes.

label: Time zone and locale
description: Time zone, daylight saving, local clock and culture.

label: Uptime
description: Boot time and how long the PC has been up.

label: Clock sync
description: Whether the clock syncs with a time server, when it last did and any error.
